integrity_notes: The one-block tail is derived from the explicit weighted separator structure; the identically distributed edge-weight theorem is not assumed to cover the anisotropic model.
No numerical experiment is used as proof of the asymptotic limit.
scientific_limitations: Independent Pareto edge weights whose length-specific exponents lie on the critical curve \(\gamma_1+2\gamma_2=2\).
No claim for dependent weights, arbitrary slowly varying tail factors, other graph ranges, or a functional limit theorem.
title: Critical Gaussian fluctuations for anisotropic Pareto weights on the range-two line
